tags.balance_change: Clasp: Critical hit rate increase when connecting items: 3 → 2; Base critical hit rate: 5 → 8
Bloodstone: Damage increase: 5% → 8%

tags.balance_change: Decree of Execution: Critical hit rate and critical damage increase against defense-broken enemies: 50% → 30%. Fixed an issue where the resilience damage provided was higher than intended.
Soul Siphon Box: Damage increase for all abilities when allies' energy is above 50%: 30% → 40%
Elemental Echo: Description adjusted to match the actual effect.
Stone Scale Barrier: Base duration: 3 seconds → 8 seconds; Duration increase per connected armor: 1 second → 2 seconds
Fairy Tear: Price: 12 → 5
Reinforced Plating: Price: 6 → 4
Provocation Statue: Reduced backpack space occupation
All abilities gain more cooldown progress when triggered by defense counters.

notes.title: 0.1.3 update
notes.content: [p]**New Features**[/p][p][/p][p]*   **Fusion Formula Preview:** When the mouse cursor is over an item that can be used as fusion material, press `Ctrl` or the Mouse Middle Button to preview relevant fusion formulas.[/p][p]*   **New Item Type: Emblems**[/p][p]    *   Emblems appear in the shop when returning after battle at the end of Round 2 and Round 6.[/p][p]    *   Only 1 Emblem can be chosen from 3 available options each time.[/p][p][/p][p]**New Items**[/p][p]*   **Abyssal Brand:** Increases the probability of 【Abyss】 items appearing in the shop. When current HP is below 50%: Gain 10 stacks of "Armor Strengthen" and "Move Damage Boost". Gain an additional 4 stacks of each for every linked 【Abyss】 item.[/p][p]*   **Oath of Vigil:** Linked moves are treated as 【Abyss】 items. The trigger condition for all 【Abyss】 items in the backpack is changed to activate when HP is not full.[/p][p]*   **Inquisitor's Badge:** Increases the probability of 【Break】 items appearing in the shop. At the start of battle: Enemies gain 25 stacks of "Toughness Damage Amplification". Enemies gain an additional 5 stacks for every linked move. Enemy recovery speed from Defense Break is reduced by 40%.[/p][p]*   **Decree of Execution:** Can only be linked to moves. Increases Toughness Damage dealt by the linked move by 20%. When the linked move is used: If the enemy is in Defense Break state, increases Critical Rate by 50% and Critical Damage by 50%.[/p][p]*   **Soul Siphon Box:** Doubles the absolute value of Stamina restored by the linked item. Whenever the linked item restores more than 5 Stamina, adds 1 stack of "Toughness Damage Reduction" to allies. When Stamina is below 50%, increases all move damage by 30%.[/p][p]*   **Lifebound Soulstone:** When taking damage: If current Stamina is above 50%, consumes 1 Stamina to block 1 damage. Can block up to 50% of the damage taken per hit.[/p][p]*   **Elemental Harmony:** Increases the probability of 【Fire】【Ice】【Lightning】 items appearing in the shop. At the start of battle: Gain 15 stacks of random buffs. Gain an additional 2 stacks for every linked item with an Element type.[/p][p]*   **Elemental Resonance:** Elemental Reactions triggered by allies no longer remove all Anomaly Gauge, but instead refill the related Element's Anomaly Gauge. However, each Elemental Explosion accelerates Anomaly status decay by 50% and reduces the effect of the corresponding Elemental Explosion by 50%. Resets when the enemy completely exits the Anomaly status.[/p][p]*   **Tainted Blood:** Increases the probability of 【Blood】 items appearing in the shop. notes.title: 0.1.1.4 update
notes.content:
The update this week brings new features for damage numbers and display. There are also numerous other adjustments and balancing changes. We look forward to more feedback from you all!

### New Features
#### 1. Damage Numbers and Combo Counts
- Display is enabled by default and can be turned off on the settings page.

### Adjustments and Optimizations
#### 1. Skill Fusion Adjustments
- Standardize the skill types before and after fusion.
- Adjust the fusion formulas for Samurai skills.
- Each item can only be used for fusion once per round.
#### 2. Character Adjustments
- **Knight**: Reduce the initial defense from 20 to 15.
- **Assassin**: Increase the initial defense from 5 to 10.
#### 3. Skill Adjustments
- Balance the numerical values of some skills.
- Adjust the algorithm for the efficiency of counter - attack accumulation in skills:
    - Reduce the counter - attack values caused by most high - level skills.
    - Increase the counter - attack values caused by Posture - break and Super Armor skills.
- Adjust the action speed of some Samurai skills.
#### 4. Item Adjustments
- **Conversion Armor**: Reduce the added "Mighty" stacks from 6 to 5.
- **Sharp Fang Bracelet**: Decrease the number of link points from 3 to 2.
- **Self - Sacrifice Potion**: Lower the added "Mighty" stacks from 18 to 15.
- **Arrogant Helmet**: Decrease the added HP from 50 points to 40 points.
- **One - Breath Potion**: Reduce the price from 8 gold coins to 6 gold coins.
- **Crimson Gauntlets**: Decrease the number of "Bleeding" stacks applied to enemies on hit from 2 to 1.
- **Small Shield**: Now increase the posture damage of linked skills by 1% for every 5 points of posture.
- **Resilient Gauntlets**: Now increase damage at low HP, but with a reduced increase value.
- **Ritual Armor**: Decrease the added HP from 75 to 60 and no longer provide "Sturdy".
- **Blood Dagger**: Change the applied "Bleeding" stacks from 3 to 2 when activating a skill.
- **Doomed Resolution**: Reduce the additional damage dealt to the enemy per skill hit from 10 points to 8 points, and reduce the additional damage received when our character is hit from 5 points to 4 points.
- **Jealous Flame Coat**: Decrease the added "Fortitude" stacks from 20 to 18, reduce the "Sturdy" stacks provided by each inlaid rune from 3 to 2, and increase the "Valor" stacks provided to the enemy from 3 to 4.

### Bug Fixes
#### 1. Item Effects
- **Power Shard**: Fix the issue of additional removal of skill damage bonus effects.
- Fix the numerical errors in all effects that increase the posture limit.
#### 2. Skills
- Standardize the described number of damage segments and the actual number of damage segments for Assassin skills.

notes.title: 0.1.1 update
notes.content:
Dear brave warriors,

Greetings! Since the major update in April, we've received a wealth of suggestions and feedback from you all. Your insights have been invaluable in enhancing the game experience, and we'd like to express our sincere gratitude to every player who has offered criticism and advice. 

Many players have expressed a desire to continue playing after achieving ten consecutive victories, and some have also suggested the ability to battle friends. In response, we've introduced a new feature called the "Hall of Honor." Alongside this new addition, we've also included 12 brand - new items in this version, aiming to provide you with more diverse build options. Additionally, we've made adjustments to certain game mechanics, item effects, and the leaderboard function. Here are the detailed update notes:

### New Features
#### 1. Hall of Honor
- Players can save the character data of their 10 - win runs in the Trial Mode.
- View detailed information of the saved character data in the "Hall of Honor":
    - Inventory status and total item value.
    - Saving time.
    - Win - loss record.
- Each character saved in the Hall of Honor has a corresponding "Character Code".
- Players can enter each other's "Character Codes" in the Hall of Honor to initiate a battle (Internet connection is required to retrieve character data).
#### 2. Live - streaming Mode
- Can be enabled in the settings. Once enabled, the names of opponents will no longer be directly displayed during battles.

### New Items
#### 1. Resilient Gauntlets
- Can only be linked to skills.
- The linked skill deals additional posture damage based on the player's HP status (15% additional when HP is below 75%, 25% when below 50%, and 50% when below 25%).
#### 2. Reinforced Armor Plates
- Can only be linked to armor.
- At the start of the battle: For each linked armor piece, increase the player's maximum posture value by 10 points and add 1 stack of "Fatigue".
#### 3. Power Shard
- Can only be linked to skills.
- At the start of the battle: The linked skill's damage increases by 1% per second. The damage - increasing effect resets and restacks after the skill hits.
#### 4. Bone Breaker
- Can only be linked to skills.
- The linked skill deals additional damage to enemies with over 50% HP (50% additional when the enemy's HP is full, 25% when at 50% HP).
#### 5. Filthy Armor
- At the start of the battle: Randomly add 20 stacks of a negative effect. For each linked item, add an additional 10 stacks.
- 10 seconds after the start of the battle: Convert all negative effects on the player into twice the number of corresponding positive effects.
#### 6. Wrestler's Belt
- Can only be linked to skills.
- For every 10 stacks of "Mighty" the player has, the linked skill consumes 1 less point of stamina.
#### 7. Reckless Shield
- Each stack of "Sturdy" increases counter - attack damage by 3%.
#### 8. Stone Scale Barrier
- Increase the player's block damage reduction rate by 99% within the first 5 seconds of the battle.
- Whenever the player blocks: The higher the player's HP percentage, the more stamina is consumed, with a maximum additional consumption of 40 points.
#### 9. Poisonous Bee Tail Ring
- For every 1% of stamina lost, increase counter - attack damage by 4%.
#### 10. Fingerless Gloves
- Can only be linked to skills.
- The linked skill consumes 3 less points of stamina.
- If the linked skill is a posture - break skill, it consumes an additional 3 less points of stamina, but the damage is reduced by 15%.
#### 11. Boxer's Chestplate
- Each time the player activates a posture - break skill, add 8 stacks of "Mighty" to themselves.
- Each time the player's posture - break skill is interrupted, add 5 stacks of "Mighty".
#### 12. Cloud - Splitting Needle (Replaces the Grounding Boots as a fusion result. Grounding Boots are added to the shop pool)
- Can only be linked to skills.
- The linked skill consumes 2 less points of stamina.
- When the linked skill hits: Apply a Thunder elemental anomaly value equal to 65% of the base damage to the enemy.

### Adjustments and Optimizations
#### 1. Character - related Adjustments
- **Knight**: Decrease HP, increase defense. Increase skill damage.
- **Samurai**: Slightly reduce early - game posture damage.
- Reduce the damage of all characters' Super Armor Skills and Posture - break Skills. Increase the stamina consumption of Samurai and Assassin's Super Armor Skills.
- Increase all characters' late - game HP.
- Slightly increase all characters' posture recovery speed.
- Significantly reduce the efficiency of all characters' counter - attack progress accumulation while in the hit state.
- Increase all characters' base block damage reduction rate from 20% to 25%.
- Delay the timing of all characters' counter - attack progress decrease, but increase the decrease speed.
#### 2. Interruption Mechanism Adjustment
- Super Armor Skills cannot interrupt Posture - break Skills.
- When a Posture - break Skill hits a Super Armor Skill, it no longer directly puts the user into a vulnerable state, but deals 3 times the damage and posture damage.
#### 3. Block - related Adjustments
- A character can block when hit again after being in the hit state for 2 seconds.
- If a counter - attack is interrupted, part of the counter - attack progress will now be refunded.
#### 4. Shop Mechanism Adjustment
- The maximum number of identical skills that can be purchased from the shop is 2.
#### 5. Element - related Mechanism Adjustments
- The elemental anomaly value added by items is now calculated only based on the base damage of skills.
- Strengthen the negative effects during the abnormal state.
- The abnormal state ends 3 seconds after entering. Using an attack of the corresponding abnormal state during this period will slightly extend the duration of the abnormal state.
- Adjust the effects of element - related items.
#### 6. Item Effect Adjustments
- Adjust the prices of some skills.
- Add elemental attribute classifications to some items.
- **Arrogant Helmet**: Change the added "Sturdy" from 6 stacks to 4 stacks, and the "Sturdy" added for each linked armor piece from 4 stacks to 2 stacks.
- **Steady Ring**: Increase the counter - attack progress increase when blocking from 4% to 8%.
- **Dexterous Pendant**: Now add 2 stacks of "Fortitude" for each linked item, but reduce the added "Sturdy" to 1 stack.
- **Hybrid Flask**: At the start of the battle, gain 6 stacks of random buffs. Change the number of random buff stacks gained when using the potion from 6 to 4.
- **Dark Moon Emblem**: Change the price from 10 gold to 7 gold.
- **One - Breath Potion**: Change the recovered stamina from 50 points to 75 points.
- **Small Shield**: New effect: At the start of the battle, for each stack of "Sturdy", gain 1 stack of "Fortitude", up to a maximum of 15 stacks.
- **Killing Intent Bell**: Change the price from 6 gold to 3 gold.
- **Obsidian Armor**: When HP is below 50%, directly gain 16 stacks of "Fortitude", and an additional number of stacks equal to 8 times the number of linked armor pieces.
- **Energy Beetle**: Change the recovered stamina for the player and the stamina lost by the enemy from 4 points to 6 points.
- **Giant Boots**: Instead of clearing all "Fortitude", only clear the "Fortitude" added by the Giant Boots.
- **Ritual Armor**: At the start of the battle, increase the player's maximum HP by 75 points and gain 5 stacks of "Sturdy".
- **Shining Ring**: At the start of the battle, add 4 stacks each of "Valor", "Fortitude", and "Mighty". For each linked light - attribute item, add an additional stack of each.
- **Reverse the Tide Potion**: Temporarily remove this item.
- **Patient Incense**: Recover an additional 50 posture when counter - attacking.
- **Frost Iron Shield**: Increase the counter - attack damage increase from 30% to 50%, and the counter - attack progress increase when blocking from 5% to 15%. Increase the counter - attack damage increase when blocking from 3% to 5%.
- **Obscure Ring**: New effect: At the start of the battle, apply 3 stacks each of "Fatigue", "Vulnerable", "Weakness", and "Retreat" to the enemy.
- **Frosty Claw**: Change the HP threshold for triggering from below 50% to below 85%.
- **Energetic Greaves**: Change the recovered stamina from 3 times to 5 times.
- **Impact Shield**: Change the gained "Weakness" from 5 stacks to 2 stacks, and the posture damage increase for each linked skill from 12% to 14%.
- **Blessing Potion**: Change the gained buff stacks from 15 to 22.
- **Candle Flame**: Change the damage bonus per stack of "Fortitude" from 0.6% to 0.8%.
- **Tourniquet**: Change the provided "Fortitude" at the start of the battle from 10 stacks to 35 stacks.
- **Imbalance Relief Potion**: Change to increase the posture limit by 30.
- **Danger Cleansing Potion**: New effect: Recover 1 HP for each stack of buffs.
- **Hunting Impulse**: New effect: The linked skill deals 15% additional damage to bleeding enemies, and the damage of the linked skill increases by 0.3% for each stack of bleeding on the enemy.
- **Thorn Cross**: Change the "Bleeding" added to the enemy when attacking from 4 stacks to 3 stacks, and from 4 stacks to 2 stacks when being hit. When hitting or being hit, change the "Bleeding" added for each linked blood - type item from 2 stacks to 1 stack.
- **Champion Helmet**: New effect: Each linked armor piece increases posture and HP by 15 points.
- **Bulky Armor**: Instead of clearing all "Fortitude", only remove the "Fortitude" added by the Bulky Armor.
- **Profane Cross**: The linked skill now deals + 30% damage. However, reduce the life - steal from 60% to 45% and decrease the number of link points.
- **Expert Shoes**: Increase the stamina limit increase at the start of the battle from 30 to 60. And for every 5 points of consumed stamina, the linked skill's damage increases by 1%.
- **Raptor Statue**: Redesign the item effect. Now it triggers different effects based on the type of linked item.
#### 7. Leaderboard Display Adjustment
- The leaderboard will now be displayed in two calculation dimensions: weekly and monthly.

notes.title: Week Data of the Demo and the Optimization
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,
Today marks exactly one week since the launch of the latest demo for Wretch: Divine Ascent.
 We never expected this demo to attract so many players — we’ve received the amount of feedback and suggestions (in the best way)! 🙌
Here’s a quick update on what we’ve achieved in just one week:

1.Our Steam wishlists have surpassed 10,000! (Before the demo, we were around 2,000.)
2.We were featured at the top of Steam’s official Free Demos section, alongside games like FC 25 and Shape Of Dream
3.We ranked in the top 3 trending free demos on Steam!
4.Our Ranking List server received over 600,000 data uploads from in-game activity.
5.Our Bilibili followers have nearly doubled, and our Heybox followers have grown nearly 6x!

And now, a look at what’s coming next — based on all the feedback we've seen so far, here are some of the key features we’re planning to adjust in future updates. The demo will stay online with regular updates to improve and refine the experience:

1.Overwhelming move counter mechanics: We don’t plan to remove counter relationships between moves, but we will adjust the counter effect to reduce the feeling of helplessness caused by bad luck.
2.Low survivability with only 3 HP bars: There is a healing mechanic in place, but the UI doesn’t show it clearly yet — that’ll be fixed. We’re also continuing to explore better failure tolerance.
3.Limited viable builds: We’re actively working on this — beyond number tweaks, we’ll also add new items to support more varied playstyles.
4.Can’t preview item crafting results: This is already in the works! It involves UI and system updates, so it’ll take a little more time.
5.Cluttered backpack UI, unclear combo and cooldown displays: Yes, we’re well aware of the UI issues — we’re planning a major visual update to address these.
6.Lack of guidance for new players: We're brainstorming solutions now. Once confirmed, we’ll work on building a proper tutorial/guide system.
7.Potion sometimes doesn’t work, combo input issues: Potions may behave counterintuitively right now — we’ll optimize both the mechanics and fix related bugs/UI issues.
8.Crashes, freezes, FPS drops: These are performance-related problems. Since we currently only have one programmer, our focus is still on core features first. That said, performance optimizations will come before full release.
9.Request for an economy system (e.g. rewards from battles): Something we’d love to add, but it’ll have to wait until after the core systems are in place.
10.Want to keep playing after 10 wins: We’re designing a new system that allows you to continue using your “10-win” character — something to look forward to!
11.Other suggestions like Pre-battle combo previews, storage box improvement,  better filter/memory functions in the codex, more informative tooltips, super Overload level indicators, and fixes to various bugs...All of these are on our to-do list — they’ll take time, but we’re working on them step by step.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone who’s sent feedback, streamed the game, or made content ❤️
Also, we would like to express our heartfelt thanks to player Adam Cook for the invaluable help with the English translation of the game. We truly appreciate your love and support of the game. ❤️
 
Game development is a long journey, but your support gives us so much motivation. Let’s keep making Wretch: Divine Ascent better together!

Ongopogo
 April 24, 2025

Greetings Warriors,

Since our April major update, we've received extensive player feedback. While future version adjustments remain under discussion, we'll share a comprehensive adjustment plan this week. First, let's focus on this week's update featuring game mechanic refinements and balance changes affecting characters, skills, equipment, and elemental interactions. We've also optimized and fixed leaderboard server issues caused by massive player data uploads.

1. Core Mechanic Changes
Elemental Interaction Fixes & Adjustments
Frostfire Reaction: Damage reduced to 18% of max HP
Fixed Thunderfire/Icethunder bugs: Damage reduced to 12% of max HP
Slightly increased base HP for all characters in early-game
Improved counterattack buildup efficiency across all characters

2. Samurai Skill Adjustments
Thrust: Damage & Posture Damage ↓10%
Chain Slash Kick: Damage & Posture Damage ↑25%
Spinning Kick: Faster recovery frames
Mind's Eye Combo: Posture Damage ↑12%

3. Knight Skill Adjustments

Lion Shield: Reduced linkable node count
Conversion Armor: Stamina cost/s 20 → 10, "Mighty" stacks gained 5 → 7
Bloodthirst Vial: Removed HP penalty
Shock Gauntlets: Removed extra stamina cost
Portable Vessel: Activation chance 50% → 40%
Impact Shield: Posture Damage boost per linked skill 10% → 12%
Iron Bracers: Now grants 15% Damage & 20% Posture Damage
Malice Helm: Starts combat with +50 "Fortitude" stacks
Broken Sword: Damage bonus ↑30% → 40% (description clarified)
Frostiron Shield: Increased counterattack damage, new effect: +5% parry buildup during blocks
Small Lightning Rune (inventory): Stamina recovery +8% → 10%
Lightning Rune (inventory): Stamina recovery +12% → 15%
Champion Helm: Stamina restored per armor link 20 → 30, grants 15 "Mighty" stacks
Champion Buckler: New effect: Applies 24 "Fatigue" stacks to enemies at combat start

notes.title: 0.1.0.2 update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the April update is here! This time we've added quality-of-life improvements, made adjustments to the equipment system, and finally launched the in-game leaderboards. Challenge your limits!
1. Narrations
Added in-game narrations and subtitles (currently English voice only)
Triggered by specific player actions
Each character now has unique combat narrations alongside general ones

2. Elemental Attributes
Reworked Fire/Ice/Thunder elemental effects on [Skills]
Elemental skills now build corresponding [Elemental Anomaly Value] on hit (scales with skill damage)
Enter [Elemental Anomaly State] when a threshold is reached (special debuff with visual FX)
Trigger Elemental Detonation when hitting anomaly-afflicted enemies with specific counter-element skills
Detonating one anomaly state clears all others
Updated elemental visual effects

3. Equipment Rework

3.1 Core Changes
Reworked most equipment effects:
Strengthened build-defining effects, removed generic "all-rounder" modifiers
Reduced penalties on low-tier equipment
Examples:
Spiked Gloves:
Old: +5% skill cooldown speed; On hit: 30% chance to apply "Bleed" to allies
New: On hit: Apply "Bleed" to enemies
Gauntlets (Basic):
Old: Start combat with 2 "Valor" stacks
New: +10% Posture Damage on skill hit

3.2 Rarity Adjustments
Adjusted equipment rarities to better reflect build potential:
Obsidian Armor: Purple → Blue
Cross Idol: Purple → White
Horseshoe: White → Blue

3.3 Visual Updates
Resized/redesigned icons for:
Hunting Impulse
Ember Remnant
Crimson Iron Helmet → Flame Circlet (icon+size)
Blood Vial → Bloodstone (icon+size)

3.4 System Changes
Added elemental-themed equipment
Added gem sockets to certain skill-enhancing gear
Revised fusion formulas (examples):
Knight:
Royal Assault = Shoulder Charge + Frost Gauntlet → Shoulder Charge + Buckler
Samurai:
Quad Slash = Twin Slash + Frost Gauntlet → Twin Slash + Horseshoe

4. Trials Leaderboard
Added competitive leaderboards with:
Categories:
Weekly Trials / All-Time Records
10-Win Streaks / Battle Points / Average Wins
Rules:
Local leaderboards update immediately after matches
Server synchronization every 60 minutes
Only valid records count (anti-cheat verification)

5. Other Improvements
Moved combat replay button position
Reworked [Sturdy]/[Fatigue] effects: Now affect Posture Damage taken instead of recovery speed
Added tutorial videos
Adjusted status bar colors and skill UI text
Various bug fixes and stability improvements

notes.title: Version 0.0.9 Update
notes.content:
**Latest Update Highlights**  
We've restructured core combat mechanics and item systems to refresh your experience! Key changes include:
### 1. Block System  
-  **Perfect Block** and **Panic Block** removed from default actions  
-  Increased damage reduction during blocking  
-  Blocking/Being hit no longer generates **Momentum** for skills  
### 2. Counterattack Revamp  
-  **Counter** gauge now scales with enemy attack damage  
- Can activate Counter even while staggered  
- Full Counter gauge: Instant **Stamina** recovery + massive Momentum boost  
-  Counters grant same damage reduction as blocking  
-  Enemy Counter gauge unaffected by your counters  
### 3. Posture Breakdown  
-  Slower natural **Posture** recovery  
-  Extra damage when entering **Breach** state  
-  Breach state: Clears Counter gauge & all Momentum  
-  Faster Posture recovery during Breach, but:  
  -  No Momentum generation  
  -  Can't block until fully recovered  
### 4. Item System Overhaul  
- **Block-related items** redesigned:  
  ➔ Focus on damage reduction/survival boosts  
- **Posture items**:  
  ➔ Adjusted numerical values  
  ➔ Enhanced Breach-state potions  
- **Counter-triggered effects** rebalanced  
-  **Equipment categories**: Helmets/Shields/Armor (replaces Armor type)  
### 5. Multiplayer Upgrade  
-  Smarter matchmaking:  
  ➔ Prioritizes opponents with similar W/L records  
  ➔ Enemy IDs now visible  
  ➔ Real-time data updates for competitive modes  
-  New victory rule: Simultaneous death in Exploration/Trials counts as win  
**Visual Updates**  
-  Redesigned skill effects:  
  Super Armor (gold) / Counter (blue) / Posture Break (red)  
**Jump in now** to experience more strategic combat and fairer PvP matchmaking!

notes.title: 0.0.8 update
notes.content:
We're working to make in-game guidance more specific and straightforward, allowing players to better understand skill acquisition priorities and sequence during character building.
New Features:
Move Types: Combat moves are now categorized into three types:
Regular Moves: Can be interrupted by attacks without "Momentum Break" effect during execution
Super Armor Moves: Character maintains super armor status through most of the animation, immune to regular attack interruptions
Momentum Breaker Moves: Attacks carry "Momentum Break" effect. Hitting super-armored opponents will clear their entire Poise meter, leaving them vulnerable
Counter Moves: Character enters special super armor state during execution. These moves can interrupt actions of super-armored opponents
Optimizations:
Knight Class
4-Combo Effect: Changed from "+1 Super Armor Level on first move after counter" → "Restores 15 HP when countering"
5-Combo Effect: Changed from "+1 Super Armor Level and +50 Defense throughout combo" → "+100 Defense during combo execution"
Items
Move Category:
All combat moves have been assigned specific move types
This translation maintains gaming terminology conventions while ensuring mechanical clarity. Key terms like "Poise meter" and "Super Armor" align with common action game vocabulary.
